popCulture.title: Psamathe (daughter of Crotopus)
popCulture.description: Daughter of Crotopus who bears Linus to Apollo; when the infant is exposed and killed, Apollo's plague avenges him — carefully distinct from Psamathe the Nereid.

popCulture.title: Linus (mythology)
popCulture.description: Psamathe's son by Apollo — the exposed infant whose death brings divine vengeance on Argos; one of several Linus figures in Greek song myth.

popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias preserves the Argive tale of Psamathe, Linus, and Apollo's wrath — the Crotopid house as local etiology of plague and mourning song.

popCulture.title: Apollo
popCulture.description: Psamathe's lover and Linus' father — the god who punishes Crotopus' city when the exposed child is torn by dogs.
